name: T-65 X-wing starfighter
description: The Incom T-65 X-wing starfighter was the primary all-purpose starfighter of the Rebel Alliance and its successor governments. Known for its versatility and exceptional combat performance, it was a favorite with Rebel and New Republic pilots. Possessing deflector shields, a hyperdrive, an R2 astromech for repairs and navigation, and a complement of proton torpedoes, the X-wing allowed the Rebellion to launch raids in Imperial space with improved odds of a successful mission.

data.name: T-65 X-wing starfighter
data.max_speed: 1,050 km/h (higher speeds possible with deflector shields on)
engine: Incom 4L4 fusial thrust engines (4) rated at 300 KTU
sensor: Fabritech ANs-5d full-spectrum transceiver (some configurations include PA-9r long range phased tachyon detection array and PG-7u short range primary threat analysis grid)
data.target: Fabritech ANq 3.6 tracking computer and IN-344-B "Sightline" holographic imaging system
armament: Taim & Bak KX9 or IX4 laser cannons (4)
data.consumables: 1 week, but extendable by outer pods
